title: Omnia guest template manifest
description: Validates `templates/guest/manifest.yaml`: the single source of truth for the Omnia base-repo scaffold source-to-target mappings, owned by omnia-exemplar and fetched at build time by the Emery omnia target adapter.

schema-version.description: Manifest schema version. Bump on breaking wire changes.

tokens.description: The closed set of `<UPPER_SNAKE>` tokens template sources may carry, with a one-line description each.

path-mode.description: Omnia templates are static: target paths are written verbatim.

target.description: Relative path under the project root.

proof.description: `exact`: token-free and byte-identical to the repository root file at `target`. `seed`: project-start baseline; rendered with values.yaml and syntax-checked only.
